quantifiers: Worst case over inputs; every randomized no-guess algorithm; epsilon in (0,L-1]. Noninteger 1+epsilon is represented by floor((1+epsilon)^(2m)) equiprobable binary prefix codes rather than an invalid noninteger branch count.
statement: The same oracle lower bound is Omega((1+epsilon)^(2T/3)) when both ratio and Bellman-error assumptions hold.
